pictures.author: Clint Budd
pictures.observations: Open rectangular roof aperture between fixed dark side roofs and retracted pale end panels, two longitudinal white girders/end lattice structure, four tall tapered mast frames and stays. Rounded blue/red glazed river facade; separate Arms Park remains outside the stadium asset. Viewed only, no pixels copied.

pictures.author: G-13114
pictures.observations: Exposed upper concrete/steel frame beneath curved dark roof/blue fascia, red bands and glazed lower frontage; round tapered mast legs/cross braces, diagonal stays and nearby cylindrical stair/service core. Separate riverbank/water infrastructure remains native.

pictures.author: Peter Morgan / Mooganic
pictures.observations: Close tapered mast frame with pointed paired heads, open white bracing, horizontal ties and diagonal support stays.90.3m is stated in the photo caption and is used only as an unverified visual height allocation.

pictures.author: Philip Halling
pictures.observations: Closing roof shows gridded underside and deep white longitudinal trusses over several red seating bands. Concert stage, lights, crowd and screens are event fixtures and are excluded. Model represents a fixed open-roof neutral rugby configuration.

pictures.author: al_green / Alan
pictures.observations: Distinct lower straight north stand with two main seating bands, glazed/framed backing and corner height gaps between taller three-tier side stands; roof trusses and a suspended neutral display above. Standard rugby goal shape informs the neutral pitch; sponsor text/live graphics/crowd are not copied.
